name: react-best-practices
description: React and Next.js performance + data-layer rules

metadata.description: 86 rules across 9 categories for React and Next.js — eliminating waterfalls, bundle size, server-side performance, re-renders, rendering, JS micro-optimizations, and a TanStack Query API/data-layer section (query keys, invalidation, enabled gating, infinite queries, SSR prefetch, optimistic updates). Rules load one file at a time from an index.

plugins.name: react-best-practices
plugins.description: Use when writing, reviewing, or optimizing React/Next.js code, or when working with @tanstack/react-query.
